tool.title: Release package via GitHub Actions release workflow
tool.description: Build, tag, and publish an npm package tarball to GitHub Releases and GitHub Packages registry via workflow_dispatch across any repository.

inputs.name: package
inputs.description: The package being released. Default: root package in the target repository.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: The semver version string to release (e.g. '0.1.0').

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: Target repository full name (e.g. 'litlfred/cat-harness', 'litlfred/bootstrap-tools'). If omitted, runs in the current repository.

outputs.name: tag
outputs.description: The tag created by the workflow, e.g. `<package>-v<version>` or `v<version>`.

outputs.name: status
outputs.description: Workflow dispatch status and run URL.
